Hi!

This is the home page of this website.

About Me

Hi :) I’m a highschool student from Australia. Nothing too interesting about me, but if I end up trying or testing something which has anything more than mild intellectual allure you might be able to find it here!

About This Site

I’m generally using this site to share stuff I’ve done; to localise various projects and digital trinkets. It’ll probably end up becoming a collection of programming/mathematics projects and maybe some writings on various topics/ideas.

The site design and front-end might be abysmal, but it’s expected given I’m not a graphic designer. You’ll probably have to deal with a site in aesthetic deficit. Call it “functionally minimalist” or something of similar nature as if being unable to write CSS is ‘intended’.

Meta-Information

This site is built using Jekyll and hosted on GitHub Pages. The source code is available on GitHub. TeX is rendered using MathJax.

Home

You can find various information about this site on the Home page. This is the page you’re currently reading (recursion!).

Posts

You can find stuff I’ve written on the Posts page. It differs slightly from standard online blogs, since most of the posts in there are less audience-focused (you know, the obsessive use of “we” and “you” and all the standard audience-engagement techniques we learnt when writing opinion pieces), and more like a compilation of sparse contemplations I wanted to share.

Most of these are just transferred notes/journals. Usually these are things my friends have asked me about/for, or things I thought were interesting enough to write about - a gamut of topics.

Background

You might have noticed the fluid simulation running in the background. It’s a WebGL fluid simulation powered by the Fluid-JS library. Try dragging! As far as I know this doesn’t work on mobile or smaller screens where you can’t actually see the background.

Known Issues

  • The site is not made for mobile. Some elements may not display properly on smaller screens.
  • If inline math (like $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$) doesn’t render, try manually refreshing the page.
